name: Autistica Tips Hub
description: A free Autistica resource that brings together practical tips from the autistic community alongside evidence-informed information and links.
intended_use: Browse practical ideas for everyday questions and compare community suggestions with supporting information where available.
audience_or_context: Autistic people, families and others looking for practical autism-related tips and resources.
limitations: Community tips reflect individual experiences and should not be generalised as universally effective.
The resource is not a substitute for professional medical care or individual safeguarding advice.
cost_or_access_notes: Autistica presents the resource as free; platform availability and features can change.
conflicts_of_interest: The resource is hosted and promoted by Autistica, which also develops and funds autism research and resources.

provenance.method: Official Autistica resource information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing keeps community experience distinct from evidence and does not turn inclusion into endorsement.
